description:
The system is configured to run the **EmailAdapter**, an Email‑type adapter listening on **127.0.0.1:8080**. Its health and status are monitored by a service at **192.168.1.100:9000**. All request categories are organized under the three top‑level groups **Public Works**, **Parks & Recreation**, and **Utilities**.  

In the **Downtown** service area two providers are registered. Provider **CitySourcedProvider** (ID 1) connects to https://api.citysourced.com/v1, uses API version 2.1 with key CS-API-KEY-12345, and operates in **realtime** mode. Email notifications for this provider are sent to **support@city.gov**, from **noreply@city.gov** (display name “City Services”), with the subject line “New Service Request” and the template file **templates/email_notification.tmpl**. It offers two services: **Pothole Repair** (service 101, Public Works, realtime) and **Street Light Outage** (service 102, Public Works, inheriting the provider’s realtime mode). The second provider, **ParkMaintenanceProvider** (ID 2), reaches https://api.parks.example.com, runs API version 1.0 with key PK-KEY-67890, and defaults to **batch** processing. Its catalog includes **Tree Trimming** (service 201, Parks & Recreation) and **Playground Equipment Repair** (service 202, Parks & Recreation, explicitly batch).  

The **Uptown** area is served by **UtilityProvider** (ID 3) at https://api.utilityco.com, API version 3.0, key UTL-KEY-11223, and operates in **blackbox** mode. It supplies **Water Leak Report** (service 301, Utilities) and **Power Outage** (service 302, Utilities, realtime).
